items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1962-09-19
items.q: Because some of them was on that album, Sashmo plays Fats.

ctx.x: Are we going to hear it here?

Well, we'll play it. Good. We'll play what we can get together on. Because some of them was on that album, Sashmo plays Fats. Yeah. And that's why we can do that, because they was on there. Look forward to that. Yeah.

Well, one thing we've learned from tonight's radio press conference is that it was a mere accident of history that Sashmo learned to play that trumpet when he was taken into an orphanage. Long may he go on playing those golden notes. Your questioners tonight were Charles Hayes of East African Newspapers, Eric Marsden of the East African Standard, and Leslie Wink, program organizer of KBS African National Service.
